data.gender_notes: Eshwari is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Eshwari is a name derived from Sanskrit, which means 'Goddess of Wealth'. In Hindu mythology, Eshwari is the wife of Lord Ganesha and is also known as the Goddess of Fortune. She is worshipped for prosperity, success, and abundance. The name Eshwari carries the meaning “Goddess of Wealth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Eshwari usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of wealth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes abundance, prosperity, and good fortune.
data.etymology: Eshwari belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Wealth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eshwari total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
